title: PublicHealth AirPollutionClinicPanel

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the research task on air pollution and healthcare utilization. Conducted comprehensive analysis of daily panel data linking PM2.5 to respiratory visits. Generated 11 figures, implemented statistical modeling (multiple regression showing significant PM2.5 effect: β=0.432, p=0.036), performed sensitivity analyses, and produced a 1749-word academic report with policy implications. All deliverables are in place: code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and final report in report/report.md with all referenced figures in report/images/.
